summary.text: FIRST BUNKERING AS is a private limited company registered in Kristiansand S, founded 2012-04-18. First Bunkering AS is registered for wholesale trade in fuel and fuel oil, along with other activities naturally connected to this. Surplus earned capital from the business may be used for trading in shares, units, goods and various financial instruments or products, including speculation in commodity prices, as well as general investment activities that the board considers appropriate. Its main industry code is 46.810: wholesale of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels and related products. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 82 477 035 NOK and the annual result was 769 265 NOK; operating income was up from 61 718 451 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 628 951 NOK in 2024 to 769 265 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 262 040 NOK in 2024 to 3 881 305 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is firstbunkering.no, which links to its Facebook profile. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (549300T9GFZ64IZS9L30). The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-21 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
